chapter.verse: Tu-in mi siangthote' ading sumdonna vai ah Galatia pawlpite ka vaikhak bangin note in zong tua bangin na hihding uh ahi hi.
Kong pai ciangin sumdon a om loh nadingin note khat ciat in na neihdan uh zui-in nipikal sim ni masani-in tuamkoih ahihkeileh kholkholh na nei un.
Kong tun ciangin na citpiakte uh Jerusalem ah a puak dingin muanhuai na sak uh mite laikhak kengsakin ka sawl ding hi.
Kei ka pai ding hoihtuak i sak leh zong amau tawh ka tonkhawm ding hi.
Macedonia gam nawk sawm ka hih manin Macedonia gam ka nawk khit ciangin note' kiangah kong zin ding hi.
Koikoi ka pai zongin ka khualzinna ah nong huh theih nadingun note' kiangah kong taam ding a, phalbi nangawn kong zang ding hi.
A hang pen tu-a nawk pak bek tawh kong muh ding ka ut kei a, Topa in hong phal leh note' kiangah tawlkhat sung hong taam thei dingin ka kilamen hi.
Ahi zongin Pentecost Pawi hun dong Ephesus khua ah ka taam ding hi.
A hang pen kei' adingin nasep a lianpi leh a muibun sep theih nading kongpi khat kihong a, hong langpang zong tampi om hi.
Timothy pen keimah bangin Topa' na a sem ahih manin amah hong tun ciangin note' lakah lungmuangtak a om nadingin na don un.
Tua hi a, kuamah in amah simmawh kei ta hen. Sanggamte tawh amah hong pai ding lamen ka hih manin kei' kiangah hong ciah theih nadingin a khualzin vai a lem dingin na van un.

Tu-in i sanggampa Apollos' vai ah sanggam dangte tawh note' kiangah hong hawh dingin amah nakpi-in ka hanthawn a, ahi zongin tu-a hong pai ding amah ut het lo hi. Hunpha a ngah ciangin hong pai ding hi.
Pilvang navak un. Upna sungah dingtang unla, thahatin hang un.
Na hih khempeuh uh itna tawh na sep uh hita hen.
Tu-in sanggamte aw, Stephanas-te innkuan pen Achaia gam ah thu-um masate ahihna leh mi siangthote' ading tanuk nasem dingin kipiakhia uh ahihna na thei uh hi. Note kong thumnop thu ah
hih bang mite leh mapangkhawm naseppihte khempeuh' kiangah na niamlut un.
Stephanas, Fortunatus leh Achaicus, hong tun uh ka lungdam hi. A hang pen amaute in nomau' mun-awng taang teng hong dipsak uh hi.
Keima' kha leh note' kha hong tawldamsak hi. Tua hi a, hih bang mite na theihbawl un.
Asia gam pawlpite in note hong hopih uh hi. Aquila, Prisca leh amau' inn-a pawlpi in Topa' sungah lungsim takpi tawh note hong hopih uh hi.
Sanggamte khempeuh in note hong hopih uh hi. Siangtho kinapna tawh khatlekhat na kihopih un.
Keimah Paul in keima' khut mahmah tawh hih hopihna lai kong gelh hi.
Mi khatpeuh in Topa' tungah itna a neih keileh haamsiat tuak ta hen. Kote' Topa aw, hong pai in!
Topa Jesu' hehpihna note tawh hong om ta hen.
Khris Jesu sunga vekpi' tungah keima' itna hong om ta hen. Amen.
